subject.title: Feature: Talk Mode Idle Timeout / Auto-Deactivation After Voice Wake

question: What public Talk idle-timeout contract should OpenClaw support for deactivating inactive Talk sessions after Voice Wake starts them?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds public lifecycle/config behavior and could affect cross-platform Talk semantics, so automation should not choose the permanent contract alone.

options.title: Approve additive Talk idle timeout
options.body: Add a canonical Talk config field with explicit units, bounds, disabled behavior, and reset events, then wire it through config, protocol, docs, and macOS runtime.

options.title: Scope only to Voice Wake sessions
options.body: Track activation source and auto-deactivate only sessions started from Voice Wake, leaving manually started Talk sessions unchanged.

options.title: Defer to broader voice lifecycle design
options.body: Keep this open until maintainers design a larger Talk and Voice Wake lifecycle policy that also covers realtime and mobile behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve additive Talk idle timeout
recommendation.body: Add a canonical Talk config field with explicit units, bounds, disabled behavior, and reset events, then wire it through config, protocol, docs, and macOS runtime.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest inspected history on Talk config/protocol surfaces and prior product-review context for this issue.
